scope: Publisher-level policy readings only. Individual materials, third-party exclusions, attribution and the actual processing/use still need assessment. No rights are granted by this file.
reviewer: Codex source review; not legal counsel

policies.finding: Most original text is CC BY 4.0, with exclusions. Financial data and the cash rate have separate commercial-use conditions, attribution and no-endorsement requirements. Third-party data needs separate rights. Banknote imagery, logos and multimedia have distinct restrictions.
policies.action: Check each data series and underlying owner; add required attribution and changes notices. If charging for access to covered data, disclose that RBA provides it free. Separately check banknote reproductions used in Reel imagery.

policies.finding: CC BY 4.0 generally covers website material. Exclusions include logos/branding, microdata and third-party content; customised products need their own licence check.
policies.action: Use original aggregate releases with licence-compliant attribution, source links and alteration notices. Do not apply this permission to microdata or third-party series.

policies.finding: CC BY 4.0 generally applies, except coats of arms, APRA logos and third-party material.
policies.action: Retain the required attribution and check item-level exclusions. Logo use is not licensed by the general content permission.

policies.finding: CC BY 4.0 generally applies on this website, with exclusions for state symbols, third-party material, separately conditioned content and NESA content.
policies.action: Attribute the State of NSW and retain accompanying notices. Do not imply endorsement or assume all separate NSW agency domains have the same terms.

policies.finding: The general content permission is for personal, non-commercial use. Other reproduction/adaptation ordinarily requires written permission unless specific service rules provide otherwise.
policies.action: Prioritise a licence/exception assessment for automated commercial summaries, AI inputs and media reuse. Check RSS-specific terms; do not treat public funding as an open licence.

policies.finding: Commercial AI reuse needs written permission; review before ingestion.
